criteria.title: Workbook provenance and value states
criteria.startingState: Agreed wording from tracking revision 2. Parser fixtures and exact-cell diagnostics are not executed in this package. NOT RUN. A workbook and input contract exist.
actions: Parse authorized synthetic workbook fixtures, including blank, zero, Unknown, Proposed, N/A, and empty-row cases.
Compare diagnostics to exact source cells and recorded provenance.
criteria.expectedResult: Workbook preserves source-cell provenance and distinguishes blank, zero, Unknown, Proposed and N/A. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Supported capability routes and checks
criteria.startingState: Agreed wording from tracking revision 2. R09 and R18 capability evidence is NOT RUN.
actions: For each selected capability, record the supported route and the fixed positive and negative checks.
Run those checks on the authorized evidence set when it exists.
criteria.expectedResult: Every selected capability has a supported route and fixed positive/negative checks. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Noncharging order and isolation
criteria.startingState: Agreed wording from tracking revision 2. Disposable org is not supplied. R22–R32 execution is NOT RUN.

Desktop UI: prove guest, buyer, and account isolation with readback.
criteria.expectedResult: Correct SKU, unit, quantity and price reach one noncharging order; guest/buyer/account isolation is proven. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: Fresh-org integrated controller run
criteria.startingState: Agreed wording from tracking revision 2. Controller and fresh-org acceptance are unimplemented. R52 is NOT RUN.

Record every intervention and confirm no undocumented manual configuration substitutes for automation.

criteria.title: Rerun, reconcile, and recovery

Inspect for duplicates, reconcile uncertain writes before retry, and verify recovery and handover.
criteria.expectedResult: Reruns avoid duplicates; uncertain writes reconcile before retry; recovery and handover pass. NOT RUN.

criteria.title: No source-customer data in reusable files
criteria.startingState: Agreed wording from tracking revision 2. The branch records a historical documentation-package pass; each publication rechecks. This package does not re-run that check.
actions: Inspect reusable files and new history with the allowlist, diff, links, and publication-history checks.
Confirm the absence of source-customer data, private identifiers, credentials, screenshots, and machine paths.
criteria.expectedResult: Reusable files and new history contain no source-customer data, private identifiers, credentials, screenshots or machine paths. Historical documentation-package pass only; not re-run here. Each publication rechecks.
